meta.name: CCNL Comparto Istruzione e Ricerca 2022-2024 e 2025-2027 (trattamento economico) - ARAN, Enti pubblici di ricerca (ASI compresa)

family.reason: Education and research sector, research bodies.

sources.title: CCNL 2025-2027 sui principali aspetti del trattamento economico, signed definitively on 1 July 2026 by ARAN and every union of the comparto. Tabella A2 (pp. 18-19): tabellare from 1.1.2025, 1.1.2026, 1.1.2027.
CCNL 2022-2024 (FLC CGIL did not sign). Tabella A2 (pp. 50-51): tabellare from 1.1.2024.
CCNL 2019-2021. Tabelle C1 and E1.5 (pp. 246, 256): tabellare from 1.2.2023.
CCNL Scuola 2006-2009, still in force for ferie (art. 13), malattia (art. 17) and tredicesima (art. 80).

source_document.title: CCNL Comparto Scuola 2006-2009, 29 novembre 2007

location.section: Art. 80 c. 1 (tredicesima mensilità)
location.quote: spetta una tredicesima mensilità corrisposta nel mese di dicembre di ogni anno.

provenance.note: Kept in force by the CCNL Istruzione e Ricerca 2022-2024 of 23 December 2025, art. 1 c. 13 ('continuano a trovare applicazione [...] i CCNL dei precedenti comparti'). Copy of the ARAN text hosted by the USR Friuli Venezia Giulia. Scuola section only.

notes.text: SCOPE: staff of the enti pubblici di ricerca (ASI included): levels IV-VIII (Tabella C3, one tabellare) and the ricercatori and tecnologi of levels I-III (Tabella C4, seven bands of anzianità di servizio as seniority steps), from 1.1.2024 (CCNL 2022-2024) and 2025-2027 (CCNL 2025-2027).

ALLOWANCES: the indennità di Ente of levels IV-VIII (Tabella C5) and the indennità di valorizzazione professionale of levels I-III (Tabella C6) are stated by the CCNL only as increments from 1.1.2027, their earlier amounts set by older contracts not read: not modelled, the caller pays them.

limitation.remediation: Read the indennità di Ente and di valorizzazione professionale of the earlier CCNL and add them with the 2027 increments.

notes.text: SHARED RULES: the hourly divisor, the tredicesima, the leave, absence, sickness and accrual rules are those of the scuola file of the same comparto (istruzione-ricerca-aran), not read again for the research bodies. No overtime table is modelled.

limitation.remediation: Read the research sections of the CCNL 2019-2021 (18/1/2024) for leave, absence, sickness and overtime.

notes.text: PENSION FUND: the staff of the research bodies join the Fondo Perseo Sirio, not modelled here.

limitation.remediation: Model the employer and employee rates of Fondo Perseo Sirio.

provenance.note: No text of the comparto fixes the daily quota of an unpaid absence of the scuola staff: the only daily divisor in the texts read is the 1/30 of the compenso individuale accessorio (CCNL Scuola 2007, p. 75). by_26 is kept as extracted, not sourced. Searched on 2026-10-12: the trade press reports a deduction of 1/30 of the taxable monthly pay for a day of strike and 1/30 of the RPD or CIA for the first ten days of sickness (NoiPA practice), but no statute, CCNL or NoiPA document read gives the daily quota of an unpaid absence; it stays assumed until one is found.

source_document.title: CCNL Comparto Scuola 2006-2009, 29 novembre 2007

location.section: Art. 13 cc. 2-4 (ferie)
location.quote: I dipendenti neo-assunti nella scuola hanno diritto a 30 giorni lavorativi di ferie

provenance.transformation: 32 days (c. 2), 30 for the first 3 years of service (cc. 3-4: 'Dopo 3 anni di servizio, a qualsiasi titolo prestato'). The CCNL counts the three years in any public administration ('a qualsiasi titolo prestato' / 'presso una qualsiasi pubblica amministrazione'); the tiers read the seniority with this employer, so a worker with earlier public service gets 26 (30) days when the text gives 28 (32): state the seniority with the earlier public service included.

source_document.title: CCNL Comparto Scuola 2006-2009, 29 novembre 2007

location.section: Art. 17 cc. 1, 8 (assenze per malattia)
location.quote: b) 90% della retribuzione di cui alla lett. a) per i successivi 3 mesi di assenza;

provenance.note: Job kept 18 months within the three years before the day (the CCNL sums 'le assenze per malattia verificatesi nel triennio precedente' the last episode): 540 days of 30-day months over a window of 3 years; 9 months (270 days) in full, 3 (days 271-360) at 90%, 6 (days 361-540) at 50%. The window ends on the sick day, not on the start of the last episode. The cut of the accessory pay of the first 10 days (D.L. 112/2008 art. 71 c. 1) is not modelled.

reviews.scope: Tabellare and seniority bands of the research bodies, 2024-2027.
findings: New file for the research bodies of the comparto Istruzione e Ricerca: Tabelle C3 and C4 of the CCNL 2022-2024 and 2025-2027, read on the ARAN texts.
